stories.title: Supreme Court dismisses former Delhi Mayor’s plea against ‘midnight raid’ by U.P. Police

en.title: Supreme Court dismisses former Delhi Mayor's plea against 'midnight raid' by U.P. Police
en.summary: India's Supreme Court rejected a former Delhi Mayor's petition challenging a nighttime police operation by Uttar Pradesh Police, directing the petitioner to seek remedies through appropriate local police channels.

stories.title: Three of family killed after milk tanker hits motorcycle in Koppa

en.title: Three of family killed after milk tanker hits motorcycle in Koppa
en.summary: A milk tanker collided with a motorcycle in Koppa, resulting in three family members' deaths while a 12-year-old girl survived the incident.

en.summary: Leaders of Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland have coordinated together, presenting a new challenge to United Kingdom unity.

stories.title: Gurgaon hit-and-run: Car driver arrested, attempt-to-murder charge added after CCTV probe

en.summary: Gurgaon Police arrested a car driver and upgraded charges to attempt-to-murder following CCTV footage analysis of a hit-and-run incident that generated social media outrage.

stories.title: Paytm shares drop 3% after govt shields UPI payments only up to Rs 2,000 from charges. Should you buy the dip?

en.title: Paytm shares drop 3% after govt shields UPI payments only up to Rs 2,000 from charges. Should you buy the dip?
en.summary: Paytm's stock declined after the government restricted charge-free UPI transactions to Rs 2,000, creating uncertainty about revenue from higher-value payments. The stock had recently reached a 52-week high before this announcement.

stories.title: Solar Industries shares crash 9% after acquisition of South Africa’s Omnia Holdings for Rs 12,951 crore

en.title: Solar Industries shares crash 9% after acquisition of South Africa's Omnia Holdings for Rs 12,951 crore
en.summary: Solar Industries announced an all-cash acquisition of South Africa's Omnia Holdings for Rs 12,951 crore, intended to expand its explosives and blasting operations globally. The market reacted negatively with a sharp share price decline.

stories.title: KEC International shares rally 6% after securing new orders worth Rs 1,303 crore across multiple business segments

en.title: KEC International shares rally 6% after securing new orders worth Rs 1,303 crore across multiple business segments
en.summary: KEC International won Rs 1,303 crore in new orders for transmission, distribution, cables, and conductors businesses. The company's year-to-date order intake now exceeds Rs 7,600 crore, supporting its growth prospects.

stories.title: Raymond share price rally 8% as aerospace subsidiary wins multi-programme orders

en.title: Raymond share price rally 8% as aerospace subsidiary wins multi-programme orders
en.summary: Raymond's aerospace subsidiary secured multi-programme orders for over 300 part numbers with annual business potential of around Rs 33 crore. Production is scheduled to begin in 2026 and 2027.

stories.title: PNC Infratech shares tank 20%. What’s triggering the steep plunge on Tuesday?

en.title: PNC Infratech shares tank 20%. What's triggering the steep plunge on Tuesday?
en.summary: PNC Infratech's share price fell sharply after NHAI extended a three-year debarment related to the Awadh Expressway, preventing the company from bidding on major road projects. The company is exploring legal options while continuing its current projects.
